title: Mosaics – 6 – Shards of Glass
snippet: Mosaics – 6 – Shards of Glass Soviet mosaics trace their origins to the revival of coloured glass tesserae by Mikhail Lomonosov (1711–1765) during the Russian Empire. Between 1748 and 1765, he developed more than four thousand glass formulations in an experimental workshop in St Petersburg, enabling the Russian interior to develop local resources and materials for the production of large-scale mosaics. Hemingway Knows Nothing challenges western understanding of war
snippet: Western conceptions of war have often been shaped by the writing of famous authors such as Ernest Hemingway. Artur Dron’s new book offers a new take on these established norms, showcasing how experiences in Ukraine are often shaped by the everyday realities of each individual soldier or civilian.
